newsitem.title: CANADA: H.J. Heinz plans Canada sweet goods center.
newsitem.headline: H.J. Heinz plans Canada sweet goods center.

text.p: Heinz Bakery Products, a division of H.J. Heinz Co of Pittsburgh, said on Thursday it had chosen Trenton, Ontario as the site for its North American Sweet Goods Centre.
It said it would transfer manufacturing, cold storage and distribution from three existing sites in Toronto, Mississauga and Buffalo, New York to Trenton, on the north shore of Lake Ontario.
About 220 new jobs would be created in the Trenton area, it said.
Heinz Bakery Products said it was a leading manufacturer of frozen bakery products for the in-store bakery and foodservice markets in North America.
